description: This Java interface 'MetadataHeaders' defines a collection of MetadataHeader objects, providing methods for creating and parsing metadata headers, with sorting based on compareTo method. It serves as a part of the Eclipse Ditto model for handling metadata headers in a header set.

classes.name: MetadataHeaders
classes.description: A SortedSet of MetadataHeader objects, providing creation and parsing methods, with ordering based on compareTo.

methods.description: Creates a new instance of MetadataHeaders via the factory method.

methods.description: Parses a CharSequence representing a JSON array into a MetadataHeaders instance.
